high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by thecosmologicalway. The post features a visually striking image of a plasma ball, which is a device that produces plasma through the ionization of gases. The plasma appears as bright, colorful filaments extending outward from a central red sphere, creating a dynamic and energetic visual effect. The text overlay on the image reads: PROTONS & NEUTRONS As the universe is cooling down at rapid speed, quarks starting to combine into Protons and Neutrons.
